description: PostgresBackupLocation is the Schema for the postgresbackuplocations API

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: PostgresBackupLocationSpec defines the desired state of PostgresBackupLocation

enabled.description: Enabled specifies whether the Operator should periodically perform integrity checks on the contents of this backup location.

Enabled specifies whether backups from different namespaces or clusters that use
the same backup location config will be created in the current namespace

diffRetention.description: DiffRetention describes the retention policy for differential backups

number.description: Number is number of differential backups to retain

fullRetention.description: FullRetention describes the retention policy for full backups

number.description: Number is number of days for Type time or number of backups for Type count

type.description: Type represents a time period (days) or count of full backups to keep

azure.description: Azure describes the configuration for Azure backups

caBundle.description: CABundle is a PEM encoded CA bundle which will be used to validate the Azure endpoint certificate

container.description: Container describes the Azure container storage in which the backups will be stored

endpoint.description: Endpoint describes the endpoint used to connect to the blob service. Default is generally correct unless using Azure Government

forcePathStyle.description: ForcePathStyle forces the use of path-style addressing for azure operations

keyType.description: KeyType is either 'shared' or 'sas' and the default is 'shared'

repoPath.description: RepoPath describes the path to where backups and archive are stored

secret.description: Secret describes the secret that'll be used to access provided Azure containers

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

gcs.description: GCP describes the configuration for GCP backups

bucket.description: Bucket describes the location in which backups will be stored

caBundle.description: CABundle is a PEM encoded CA bundle which will be used to validate the GCS endpoint certificate

endpoint.description: Endpoint describes the GCS endpoint to be used for backup.

repoPath.description: RepoPath describes the path to where backups and archive are stored

secret.description: Secret describes the secret that'll be used to access provided GCS containers

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

pvc.description: Pvc describes the configuration for PVC based backups

keepAfterDelete.description: KeepAfterDelete describes whether the PVC should be kept once Postgres instance is deleted

storageClassName.description:
StorageClassName describes StorageClass to use for dynamically provisioning Persistent Volumes
(PVs) for a Postgres data pod during backup

storageSize.description: StorageSize describes the size of the Persistent Volume Claim (PVC) for a Postgres data pod during backup

volumeSnapshotClassName.description:
VolumeSnapshotClassName describes VolumeSnapshotClass that specifies storage provider-specific parameters
to use when taking a snapshot

s3.description: S3 describes the configuration for S3 backups

bucket.description: Bucket describes the location in which backups will be stored

bucketPath.description: BucketPath describes the path where backups and archive are stored

caBundle.description: CABundle is a PEM encoded CA bundle which will be used to validate the S3 endpoint certificate

endpoint.description: Endpoint describes the S3 endpoint to be used for backup

forcePathStyle.description: ForcePathStyle forces the use of path-style addressing for s3 operations

secret.description: Secret describes the secret that'll be used to access provided s3 bucket
